name: Oslo Børs
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified). 2025-2027: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications (Euronext's holiday calendar, published to 2027). 2028-2029: predicted from exchange_calendars and Euronext's unchanged holiday pattern; Euronext has not published those years, although the entries cite its calendar page. regular_hours: close 17:30 before 2012-08-06, 16:30 after. Oslo Børs cut trading hours by one hour on 2012-08-06; 16:30 includes the closing auction (continuous trading ends 16:20, which is the single close exchange_calendars has for 2000-2026, so its pre-2012-08-06 hours are wrong). The 17:30 close before the cut is inferred from the one-hour reduction and is dated from the start of the registry, not from a notice. Rechecked 2026-11-19 (4c-R2) against Euronext's trading-hours-and-holidays page. Fixed: the Wednesday before Easter is an Oslo half trading day every year (Euronext lists 2025-04-16, 2026-04-01 and 2027-03-24 as half trading days for Oslo only); exchange_calendars and the 2011-2024 backfill had it, but 2025-2029 did not. Added the three published dates and an easter_offset -4 early_close rule (effective_from 2025-01-01) that also generates 2028-04-12 and 2029-03-28. Half days (ADR 0013): close = the scheduled closing uncross. Euronext's own Oslo Børs half-day schedules give, for cash equities, continuous 09:00-13:00, call 13:00-13:05, uncrossing 13:05, Trading At Last 13:05-13:10, closed 13:10, in every year read: 2023-04-05 (https://www.euronext.com/en/media/7620/download), 2024-03-27 (https://www.euronext.com/en/media/10309/download), 2025-04-16 (https://www.euronext.com/en/media/12510/download), 2026-04-01 (https://www.euronext.com/en/media/14571/download) and 2027-03-24 (https://www.euronext.com/en/media/16430/download). The 2025, 2026 and 2027 production PDFs hold the table as an image; it was read from page renders of copies of the same documents supplied with the 4c-R4 and 4c8 briefs. Those five days are 13:05 (4c-R5 for 2023, 2024, 2026; 4c8 for 2025, 2027), and the easter_offset rule generates 2028-04-12 and 2029-03-28 at 13:05 too, predicted from that pattern (4c8; 4c-R5 had kept 13:00). 2011-2022 keep 13:00, exchange_calendars' value, marked unconfirmed: no readable Euronext schedule (Oslo joined Euronext in 2019; the 2022 schedule, media 4701, could not be read). Dec 24/31 are full closures (rules), as Euronext lists. Hours: no change after 2012-08-06 was found (continuous 09:00-16:20, closing at 16:20 per the 2020 Optiq migration guidelines); no 2020 COVID-19 closure. Close convention (ADR 0013, 4c-R3.5): close = end of the closing auction. Full-day close (ADR 0013, 4c8): Euronext's Appendix to Instructions 4-01/4-03, sheet 'Appendix to 4-01 Manual OPTQ', effective 3 August 2026 (https://www.euronext.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/appendix%20to%20Euronext%20Instructions%204-01%204-03%20Trading%20Manuals_0.xlsx; the 23 November 2026 version agrees), gives every Oslo equity trading group in continuous mode (O1-O9, OA-OH, OO, OT-OY) continuous trading '09:00 Random - 16:20', closing uncrossing '16:25 Random' (randomly between 16:25:00 and 16:25:30 CET, which is Oslo local time) and Trading at Last '16:25 - 16:30'. The close is therefore 16:25, not 16:30 (the end of Trading at Last). regular_hours now reads 17:30 from 2010, 16:25 from 2012-08-06 and 16:25 from 2026-08-03: the last entry is the Appendix's effective date, and 2012-08-06 is marked unconfirmed on the 2010-2024 coverage span because no earlier Euronext or Oslo Børs schedule was read (the one-hour cut of 2012-08-06 and exchange_calendars' 16:20 continuous end are consistent with 16:25). The pre-2012 17:30 remains inferred. The undated regular session shows 16:25 (the latest entry, per the repository rule); post_market and extended_hours.after_hours now open at 16:25 (Trading at Last 16:25-16:30) and keep their 16:45 end.

Notes: 'Trading hours in CET'; the closing uncross occurs randomly within 30 seconds of the stated time.
